#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int calculate(int n) {
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    if (size < 0) {
        throw domain_error("Negative array size");
    }
    vector<int> prevEven(size, 0);
    vector<int> prevOdd(size, 0);
    prevEven[0] = 1;

    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        vector<int> curEven(size, 0);
        vector<int> curOdd(size, 0);

        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            long long sumEven = 0;
            long long sumOdd = 0;

            if (opened > 0) {
                sumEven += prevOdd[opened - 1];
                sumOdd += prevEven[opened - 1];
            }
            if (opened + 1 < size) {
                sumEven += prevOdd[opened + 1];
                sumOdd += prevEven[opened + 1];
            }

            curEven[opened] = (sumEven + 1) % MOD;
            curOdd[opened] = sumOdd % MOD;
        }

        prevEven = move(curEven);
        prevOdd = move(curOdd);
    }

    return prevOdd[0];
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << calculate(n) << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
